name: animTable
meaning: logical->model anim table: 0x57a994 normal, 0x57a9c8 carrying one, 0x57a9fc carrying two

name: waypoints
meaning: node path as 6-byte s16 triples (x, z-or-y order per copy: node[0], node[2], node[1]); extent up to +0x384 inferred

name: navSearch
meaning: path search context: +0 open list head (node*), +4 active count, +8 s16 goalX, +0xA s16 goalZ

name: lastNodeTarget
meaning: last node targeted by state 4 (x at +0x390, z at +0x394); init 0x8000

name: searchHeadingStep
meaning: signed turn step used when blocked in state 3

name: renavCooldownMs
meaning: 500 ms cooldown between nav re-plans in state 1

name: stallBestDist
meaning: max Manhattan displacement from the anchor

name: stateTimerMs
meaning: ms since Sam_SetState (also jump interpolation clock)

name: pathHistory
meaning: 10-byte entries {u8 type; u8 pad; s16 x; s16 z; s16 a; s16 b}

name: followEdgeNormal
meaning: dword taken from pathHead node +0x28+4*i (edge normal) for the first edge

name: spawnYaw
meaning: yaw at Init, restored on patrol/look-after entry

name: headRecord
meaning: fake level record for the head sub-object (a WAR record, u16 words; Sam_InitHeadRecord 0x46bd3b fills it)

name: head
meaning: embedded ScnBody (HUD head icon); head+0x16 = +0x48a yaw, head fade +0x48e/+0x490, head flags +0x478. A real ScnBody member: Sam's constructor emits its ScnBody vtable

name: headRenderScratch
meaning: two 400-byte primitive buffers after the embedded head

name: headSweepPhase
meaning: 12-bit phase of the look-after head sweep

name: headYaw
meaning: head yaw offset = sin(phase)*maxAngle/360 (applied to bone 9)

name: relAngleToWolf
meaning: signed angle to Wolf relative to body+head yaw

name: trajectory
meaning: PROPERTY_SAM_TRAJECTORY, a Trajectory {u16 count; Vec3s pts[]} (the first point at +2 is Sam's home when he gives up a search)

name: patrolFlags
meaning: bit0 = sidestep MODE: while set, patrol drives with patrolSidestepDir instead of its own velocity (cleared when the stall clears)

name: chaseSoundVolume
meaning: low 15 bits: fade-in volume of Sam's run sound 0x137 (SGORUN.WAV), started at 1 and ramped to 0xff; bit 15 unused (never read or set, only kept by the bitfield stores)

name: chaseSoundBits
meaning: chaseSoundVolume as the SamChaseSoundBits view: the 15-bit volume is read and written as a bitfield

name: chaseSoundHandle
meaning: handle of sound 0x137 played while anim id 0x31 or 7

name: patrolSidestepDir
meaning: perpendicular sidestep VELOCITY used while patrolFlags bit0: set to (vel.z, -vel.x) when patrol stalls. NOT a saved position

name: investigateStopDelayMs
meaning: state 10: 200 ms grace before switching to idle anim

name: jumpPrevPos
meaning: previous interpolated jump position (for delta move)

name: lifeTimerMs
meaning: free-running ms clock (run bob phase in Sam_Render)

name: frameCounter
meaning: per-update counter mod 8 (noise poll on 0, give-up poll on 1, step check on 4)

name: restartStatePending
meaning: set by state 0xB after launching CIN01; when DAT_0071c450 clears, re-runs Sam_SetState(current)

name: frozenPickupObj
meaning: pick-up target Sam has frozen while approaching: Sam_FreezePickupTarget 0x4621a4 sends msg 0xE (classId 0) or 0x23 and stores it here; Sam_UnfreezePickupTarget 0x4621fa sends 0xF/0x24 and clears it. NOT the carried list at +0x8d2/+0x8d4

name: carriedCount
meaning: number of objects in carried[] (Sam_AddCarried/RemoveCarried; zeroed in Sam_Init)

name: carried
meaning: objects Sam is holding after a pick-up (fetchObj1/2 appended in state 0xD). Sam_DropAllCarried copies them to carryGoal.object1/2. No bounds check in Sam_AddCarried

name: targetPos
meaning: un-led target position (catch distance uses this)

name: carryGoal
meaning: SamCarryGoal: object1 = carry goal: first carried object; object2 = second carried object; destination = where to put the carried objects (+0x916 pad)

name: fetchGoal
meaning: fetch goal: object1, object2 and the picked-up flags, read by sam.cpp as one struct

name: followFlags
meaning: route bits (SamFollowBits): bit0 midRoute = the current target is an intermediate path node, set on reaching a waypoint with more than one left; bit1 dropping = committed to stepping off a ledge toward the next node; bit2 dropToNode = a planned drop to a node more than 40 below, Y velocity 2000 instead of 1000. Bits 0+1 veto the close-goal shortcut, replanning, search adoption and the stall fallback; bit1 also skips the pursuit-zone exit check

name: followBits
meaning: followFlags as the SamFollowBits view: bit 0 is written as a bitfield (0x46901f), and the reads compile as signed 1-bit fields (shl/sar)

name: trackedObjs
meaning: 8-byte entries {ScnObject *obj; s16 x; s16 z}; entry 0 = Wolf, rest sheep

name: sheepMovedAccum
meaning: raw g_dt accumulator in the sheep-guard logic (trigger 0x3000); zeroed by SetState

name: beachCsBoxCur
meaning: MODE 0x8000: id-list 0xAF (sheep pen box used for drop-spot search)

name: altHomePos
meaning: home used for goal kind 3 when MODE 0x8000

name: beachFlags
meaning: bit0 onSide2: the beach variant's second resource set (BEACHCSBOX2 176, BEACHSAMIPOS2 177, BEACHORANGEZONE2 195, BEACHGREENZONE2 196) is current. Cleared by Sam_InitBeachVariant, flipped by Sam_SwapBeachPositions; Sam_EnterLookAfterState turns the yaw by 0x800 when set

name: beachBits
meaning: beachFlags as the SamBeachBits view: bit 0 read, set and flipped as a bitfield

name: chaseFlags
meaning: bit0 chaseAfterDrop: set in Sam_OnGoalReached when Sam, carrying a sheep or the first fetch object, notices the Wolf in the hit zone and is sent to drop the load; put-down anims play at 0x3000 and SetState forces run speed 1100. Cleared when the load is down and the goal is home, and Sam goes for the Wolf

name: chaseBits
meaning: chaseFlags as the SamChaseBits view: bit 0 read and cleared as a signed bitfield

name: beachGreenZoneOtherCount
meaning: count for beachGreenZoneOther (+0xa1c, id-list 0xC4 BEACHGREENZONE2); swapped with greenZoneCount +0x80c by Sam_SwapBeachPositions

name: beachOrangeZoneOtherCount
meaning: count for beachOrangeZoneOther (+0xa18, id-list 0xC3 BEACHORANGEZONE2); swapped with orangeZoneCount +0x80e

name: sheepFlags
meaning: bit0 heardCall: set by Sam_HandleMessage on msg 0x69 (the Wolf's sheep-costume bleat, MSG_SHEEP_CALL) from inside Sam's orange zone. Sam_DetectWolf then stops the costume protecting the Wolf (mode 0x20000) and, in the moved-sheep branch, clears it and fetches the Wolf

name: sheepBits
meaning: sheepFlags as the SamSheepBits view: bit 0 read and cleared as a signed bitfield

name: firstSheepSpawnPos
meaning: position of the first class-0xB object at Init

name: catapultLoadedObj
meaning: param of msg 0x482 while fetching the Wolf (compared with g_pWolf in pre-pass -> state 0x14)

name: robotWatchPos
meaning: robot position when state 0x16 began (moved > 10 -> hit at once)
